title: Pakistan KP Province Emergency Rule Update — Oct 18, 2026
summary: A joint sitting of Parliament ratified the emergency and governor's rule in KP for two months on Oct 15, after both houses endorsed them separately. The opposition TTAP alliance called off talks with the government. PTI and allied petitions were filed at the Peshawar High Court, which set Oct 20 for the first hearing.
